game_concept: A speed quiz set in The Kingdom – Market Square, a bustling cobbled market square: the royal scribe must handle thieves while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Uninitialized Hunt: Find variables used before assignment and fix them before thieves exploit the gap.
theme: The Kingdom – Market Square: a bustling cobbled market square
core_gameplay_loop: In Market Square, repeat each round: Find variables used before assignment and fix them before thieves exploit the gap. Each round, a new scrolls challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the bugs_fixed value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 180 points of scrolls by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 180, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 3 (intro tier): Uninitialized Hunt
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Uninitialized Hunt' (Week 1 slot 15), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Market Square'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how bugs_fixed changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against thieves in Market Square.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 180 within 36 seconds.
